counter: runtime (18 bytes) does slot0 = slot0 + 1 and returns the new value.
  6000 54        PUSH1 0, SLOAD
  6001 01        PUSH1 1, ADD
  80             DUP1
  6000 55        PUSH1 0, SSTORE
  6000 52        PUSH1 0, MSTORE
  6020 6000 f3   PUSH1 32, PUSH1 0, RETURN
Every test runs against the freshly deployed state (evm/v1 does not commit test calls),
so each call counts to one, whatever ran before it and whatever value it carried.
